question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

**TIMID**
solution:
The correct answer is **''humble''**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Look at the meaning of the words given in the question:
 
 
• **Timid**- showing a lack of courage or confidence.

 
 
• **Example**- She was very timid to ask what she wanted.
 
 
 
 
 
• Look at the meaning of the other words:
 
 
• **humble**- showing a low estimate of one's importance.
 
• **confident**- who have confidence, opposite of timid.
 
• **Bold**- courageous.
 
• **Courageous**- brave and bold.
 
 
 
• We can clearly see that **confident, bold, **and **courageous** are the **antonyms** of the word timid.
 
• **Humble means showing low importance to oneself and that will be a lack of confidence.**
 
• Out of the given words **humble is closest to timid.**
 
• Hence, the right answer is *"**humble".***

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
